items.title: Chancellor John Healey targets cost of living crisis in upcoming Budget
items.summary: According to The Guardian, chancellor John Healey prepares to deliver his first Budget against a turbulent global economic backdrop, focusing on everyday fixes and breathing space for households.

items.title: Plaid Cymru demands railway and public service funding ahead of Budget
items.summary: According to BBC, welsh Finance Minister Elin Jones calls for fair treatment and extra cash for public services as Chancellor John Healey prepares his upcoming spending plans.

items.title: Marsh appoints Andy Start CBE as Senior Advisor
items.summary: According to Reinsurance News, risk and strategy firm Marsh has appointed former Ministry of Defence official Andy Start as Senior Advisor in London, effective immediately.

items.title: Anra maintains push for dedicated Italian captive regime
items.summary: According to Commercial Risk, the Italian risk management association remains hopeful that the country's insurance regulator will introduce more favourable rules for captives.

items.title: Italian insurance market adapts to mandatory nat cat scheme
items.summary: According to Commercial Risk, the Italian insurance market is currently adapting to the introduction of the country's mandatory nat cat insurance regime and the demand it has created.

items.title: Turkiye Sigorta shares fall after top executives arrested in fund probe
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, shares in Turkish insurer Turkiye Sigorta have dropped following the arrest of its chief executive and deputy chief executive as part of a market manipulation investigation.
